nodes.label: Audit System Implementation
nodes.description: Comprehensive audit logging system for copyright protection and proof of authorship. Tracks all content creation actions with cryptographic hashes, capturing user-initiated and AI-generated actions in content_audit_log and content_deposits tables.

nodes.label: Deposit Document Structure
nodes.description: JSON document structure for proof-of-creation with author information, content details, creation chain, input prompts, reference audio, and SHA-256 document hash. Designed for integration with blockchain anchoring and timestamping services.
